```{r instructor-init, include=FALSE}
library(knitr)
# NOTE: do not set knitr `fig.align` here — it interacts with Quarto's
# TOC generation and flattens the nested TOC (chapter h2 → group h3).
# Quarto's `fig-align: center` in _quarto.yml is sufficient.
opts_chunk$set(
  echo    = TRUE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  out.width = "85%"
)
options(scipen = 99, digits = 3)
```

This document contains worked solutions to the **end-of-chapter exercises** that appear after the *Quick checks* in each chapter of *Statistical Inference via Data Science: A ModernDive into R and the Tidyverse* (2nd ed.).

It is intended **for instructors only** and is *not* deployed alongside the public book at <https://moderndive.com>. Each entry shows the question — *click to expand* — followed by the solution. Section references in italics point to the section of the chapter the exercise is testing.

::: {.callout-tip title="How to render this document"}
From the repository root:

``` bash
cd instructor-solutions
quarto render
```

The rendered HTML lands in `../_instructor/index.html`. That folder is git-ignored.
:::

::: {.callout-note title="Companion instructor tooling"}
Beyond the worked solutions below, the repo's `scripts/` folder generates four self-contained, instructor-only artifacts (all gitignored — regenerate on demand):

| Artifact | Generator | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `lesson-plans.html` | `Rscript scripts/build_lesson_plans.R` | Per-chapter teaching plan: learning objectives, section outline, class-time budget, exercise mix |
| `homework-planner.html` | `Rscript scripts/build_homework_planner.R` | Browser-side filterable list of all 486 exercises; check boxes → export a set |
| `coverage-map.html` | `Rscript scripts/exercise_coverage_map.R` | Per-section exercise counts + ID ranges + difficulty histogram |
| `concept-map.html` | `Rscript scripts/build_concept_map.R` | SVG dependency graph of the 11 chapters |
| `slides/NN-slides.qmd` × 11 | `Rscript scripts/build_slide_decks.R` | Interactive revealjs decks themed in the ModernDive hex palette, with MCQ check-ins drawn from each chapter's Quick checks |
:::
